name: Granola
shortDescription: Meeting notes that sit alongside your calls. Pricing page included a $0 plan.
longDescription: Granola takes meeting notes. The pricing crawl included $0 alongside $14 and $35. Confirm free-plan limits on the pricing page. We did not install the app or join a call.
bestFor: Notes during meetings you are already in
People who want a desktop notepad more than a wiki
notIdealFor: A team wiki or long-term knowledge base
smokeTestNotes: No local install attempted (SaaS/desktop/extension or install not feasible without account).
